label: sonnet5
sourceDraft: Y al lado de kedem, hacia oriente, cincuenta codo.
spanish: Y a lado del oriente, hacia oriente, cincuenta codo.
grammarChanges: Translated h02038013002 (קֵדְמָה, dumped as the transliteration 'kedem') into Spanish as 'oriente', expressing the suffixed form rather than leaving it untranslated.

Removed the definite article from 'lado' (h02038013001, a construct noun that takes no article) and attached it instead to the following noun as 'del oriente', matching the construct-plus-direction pattern already used for the identical Hebrew phrase at 27:13 ('a lado del oriente hacia el este').
